data.one_liner: A Paginated List and Grid widget that displays items using infinite scrolling.
data.what_it_does: Provides a PaginatedList and PaginatedGrid widget that automatically requests additional items as the user scrolls to the end. It handles loading indicators, last page detection, and supports horizontal or vertical scrolling.
use_when: You need infinite scrolling or pagination for lists or grids.
You want to easily trigger a load-more callback when reaching the end of the scrollable area.
avoid_when: You are not using a paginated data source or infinite scroll pattern.
strengths: Built-in handling of loading indicators and last page states.
Easy integration with state management solutions like BLoC.
weaknesses: Requires explicit parent sizing (like Expanded or SizedBox) since the main parent is a ListView.builder.
Limited to the built-in pagination trigger based on visibility of the last item.
data.minimal_example:
PaginatedList<Movie>(
    loadingIndicator: const CircularProgressIndicator(),
    items: state.movies,
    isLastPage: state.isLastPage,
    onLoadMore: (index) => context.read<MovieBloc>().loadMore(),
    builder: (movie, index) => Text(movie.title),
)
